species_prov_id_rule: species_country_loss:20261024-r3:species_id|iso3|biome_num|lens|metric|habitat_def|marker_domain|baseline_year|year|pa_class|pa_year  (NA for null; asserted equal to the stored prov_id for every bundled row at build time)
species_layout: species/<ISO3>/index.json = one row per species (row number = si; species columns and the exponent per metric × marker domain as '<col>|<metric>|<marker_domain>'), constants.shards = the directory of the country's shards; species/<ISO3>/<lens part>_<habitat_def>.json = one shard per lens, baseline → year (or pa_class, pa_year) and habitat definition: keys, const, cols, combos, dict, rows [si, per-species values…, one array per metric × marker domain or null]; rows rebuilt by CORE.decodeSpeciesShard in report/index.html, asserted lossless against the table at build time
dropped: country_index: bbox and the per-row provenance columns (source_id, source_doi, script, run_id, checksum) — recoverable from provenance_manifest

country_summary shards: prov_id column (reconstructed client-side by the rule in bundle_manifest.prov_id_rule), source_doi, script, run_id, checksum per row (constant per table → constants / provenance_manifest); source_id kept dictionary-encoded

country_summary shards: columns not bundled — methods_version (constant per run → bundle_manifest.methods_version); n_species_r1 (r1 value on the same stratum key; not displayed); q50_r1 (r1 value on the same stratum key; not displayed)
country_summary_default: 20820 dated-roster protection rows of the 205 non-focus countries are not bundled (--compact-drop summary_dated)

species_status: only scientific_name of the species present in the 210 estimated countries is joined into species/<ISO3>/index.json (focus countries) and country/<ISO3>.json (the others); the 172,620-row table itself is not bundled (aggregates_only source)

species_country_loss: 10282504 of 10881144 rows for the focus countries (ARM, ESP, BRA, KEN, USA) are not bundled (biome > 0 rows, years other than 1850/1970/2015, protection pa_class PA/OECM and dated pa_year, demography-lens rows); the page reads the aggregates for those from country_summary

species_country_loss: 199792 baseline-year rows (lens area, year = baseline_year) are not bundled — checked row by row: R = 1, R_full = 1, A_t = A_0, point = mean = q025 … q975 = 0, committed_mid_GD 0 or null; they carry no information and the page never displays them (its species table shows year 2015 rows)

species rows: prov_id is not stored (rebuilt client-side by bundle_manifest.species_prov_id_rule, asserted equal to the stored prov_id for every bundled row); source_doi is looked up from source_id (constants.source_doi_by_source_id in species/<ISO3>/index.json); script, run_id and checksum are constant per country (index constants); q25 and q75 are not bundled for species rows (not displayed; as in r1)
species_range_country_biome: biome > 0 rows and the A_pa_* columns (only biome 0 A_km2 by year, A_range_km2, range_share go out)

not bundled at all: species_range_cell, species_z_draws, species_z_draws_supplement, luh2_cell_year, wdpa_cell_year, cell_country_biome, species_demography_lpi (incl. lpi_ids), species_demography_pm, species_country_demography, species_range_full, luh2/wdpa_country_biome_year, country_biome_area, species_z, z_priors; no WDPA / IUCN / LPI geometry or raw rows

compact country files (country/<ISO3>.json, 205 countries, 205 files): country_summary rows at weighting equal only (144,752 rows) — biome 0 · taxon ALL for every lens, metric, domain, habitat, baseline and year; area-lens biome rows (taxon ALL) and taxon-group rows (biome 0) at every year; protection biome 0 · ALL for every class, present roster, and biome rows (ALL) of the present roster; every demography row at weighting equal. Other keys (weightings group_mean / range_share, biome × taxon rows, protection by taxon) are bundled for the focus countries only

compact country files: species rows at year 2015 only (area 1850 → 2015; primary habitat only; 665,836 rows of 166,459 species × country pairs; 124,064,140 rows of those countries' tables not bundled); q025 / q975 not carried (never displayed for species rows); A_0_km2 / A_t_km2 rebuilt from the decadal series and q50 from point, each asserted equal to the table on every row; the decadal series covers the indexed species only
--compact-drop species_1970: species rows at baseline 1970 (area 1970 -> 2015, both habitat definitions) left out of the compact files

--compact-drop species_natural: species rows for the natural habitat definition (area and protection), except in countries without primary-habitat area rows (LUH2 holds no primary land there in 1850), whose natural rows are their only ones left out of the compact files
--compact-drop species_protection: species rows of the protection lens (all classes, present roster) left out of the compact files
--compact-drop summary_dated: dated-roster protection summary rows (compact files and the default rows of non-focus countries) left out of the compact files
compact_layout: country/<ISO3>.json (+ country/<ISO3>.<k>.json when over 5 MB) = {table: country_compact, part, layout (part 1: section -> file), sections}; sections: summary (compact table; constants.coverage = the key sets it holds), species_index (as species/<ISO3>/index.json; constants.shards with files and sections, constants.shards_full_only), series (columnar; CORE.decodeSeries), species:<ISO3>/<shard> (shard format + from_series, combo same; split as #k by species)
wdpa_public_gap_source: design/05-data-contracts.md §9 'Protected Planet anchor': the public WDPA holds few of these countries' protected-area polygons (CHN: 182,264 km² vs 1,460,918 km² on Protected Planet); a documented list, not a threshold; their protection rows stay in the bundle

basis: 05 §9 area basis: sum_k share_kc * h_k(t) * carea_k over all biomes incl. Rock-and-Ice (biome 0 = whole country); land = sum_k share_kc * land_frac_k * carea_k
luh2_primary_frac_source.note: primary_frac = primary_km2 / land_km2 for the whole country (biome 0); 4 significant digits; every LUH2 year of the table (the page's LUH2 line reads 1700, 1850 and the last year; the compare scatter reads the selected baseline and year)

exponent_priors_source.rows: group_level = global (one row per metric × marker domain)
exponent_priors_source.precision: full (prior parameters; the other bundle floats carry 4 significant digits)
exponent_priors_source.use: report/index.html compare view: the dashed curve y = 1 - (1 - x)^z_median beside the country points

publish_plan.note: paths are the published paths (page = index.html; data/<file> = <out>/<file>); index.html and methods_panel.md sizes are those of cop17-2026/report at build time
